blocks.text:
Transfer to the airport for your flight to Manaus; on arrival, you are met and transferred to your jungle lodge. Dinner and evening programme. From Manaus you enter the rainforest, staying in a lodge and immersing yourself in the exotic life of the jungle: walk in the forest, fish for piranhas and, on a night outing full of jungle sounds, spot the shining eyes of caimans.

Please note: arrive in Manaus before 16:00 and leave after 14:30; otherwise a private transfer to or from the lodge is charged (not included).

blocks.text: Breakfast at the lodge and a boat tour on the river, with piranha fishing from the boat. Visit a caboclo community to learn about the lifestyle, traditions and customs of the people of the Amazon, then walk in the jungle to discover the local flora and fauna: your guide explains how to survive in the forest, how to tell edible plants from poisonous ones, and traditional hunting techniques.
